nodes.label: Batch
nodes.notes: Materialized from bronze_batch_event (EventType: Started/Completed), streamed by the data generator at the first tick of grinding and the last tick of packaging -- not inferred from sensor_reading timing.

nodes.label: BatchMaterialUsage
nodes.notes: Junction table closing the batch -> material/supplier lot-traceability gap -- which material lots (and so which suppliers) fed a specific batch. BatchId is a loose, cross-plane reference to the Eventhouse's batch, same as shipment.BatchId, not a real FK.

nodes.label: LineStatus
nodes.notes: Streamed by the data generator on every Running<->Down transition (state-change log, not a per-tick heartbeat). Status: Running or Down. Reason is set on Down rows only. Feeds Availability in gold_factory_oee_daily.

nodes.label: Material
nodes.notes: Type includes 'Cocoa Nibs' -- the output of the off-site Farm Preparation phase -- alongside Sugar, Milk, Packaging.

nodes.label: SensorReadingConching
nodes.notes: Streamed in real time from the data generator to Azure Event Hub -> Fabric Eventstream -> Eventhouse. One row per metric per tick (EAV shape) so new metrics never require a schema change.
